tools.name: calculate_stay
tools.description: Evaluate Schengen 90/180 rolling-window usage for a list of trips. Returns days used in the window, days remaining, must-leave-by date, latest safe entry dates and a per-trip verdict.

tools.name: check_trip
tools.description: Check whether ONE planned trip is legal on top of existing Schengen stays. Returns compliant/warning/over plus practical advice.

tools.name: explain_90_180_rule
tools.description: Explain the Schengen 90/180 rolling-window rule with the EC 610/2013 reference and links to the interactive calculator and guide.
